subject: Platform integration: marketplace co-sell readiness for Acme Dataworks
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acmedata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform integration: marketplace co-sell readiness for Acme Dataworks

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking time last week. Per our call, Acme Dataworks and Redwood can drive a stronger GTM with a joint listing on the major cloud marketplaces plus targeted co-sell motions. To get to the AWS/Azure/GCP certification and co-sell readiness we need to align on three parallel streams: technical integration + evidence, commercial SKU mapping & pricing, and a mutual action plan for launch (timelines, assets, enablement).

I attached a short "co-sell evidence" packet and a technical evaluation checklist to help triage gaps (filenames: co-sell-evidence-list.pdf, tech-eval-checklist.xlsx). Can you confirm who on your side will own the security questionnaire and whether you have an existing marketplace SKU?

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Acme: assign an integration lead for security/evidence (due: 2029-06-19)
- Redwood: we will prepare a draft SKU mapping and pricing matrix (Ben will own; due: 2029-06-20)
- Joint: 30-minute sync next Wednesday (2029-06-19) to review gaps and dependencies

If that works I can send a calendar invite. Happy to loop legal/ops later for DocuSign/SLA items.

Best,
Connor
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: co-sell-evidence-list.pdf, tech-eval-checklist.xlsx

From: Lena Park <lena.park@acmedata.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform integration: marketplace co-sell readiness for Acme Dataworks

Connor —

Thanks for the clear plan. I'm copying our integration mailbox (integration@acmedata.com) and our security lead, Priya Shah (priya.shah@acmedata.com), who will own the questionnaire. Quick notes from our side:

- We do have a marketplace SKU but it needs to be reconciled across providers — I can share the current SKU file later today.
- I reviewed your checklist and there are two items we should flag: data residency proof for EU customers, and a small change required to how we persist KV caches that affects cold-start latency.

I'll upload our responses and the SKU export to the shared Drive folder you suggested (please confirm the link) and we can slot the Wednesday sync.

Best,
Lena
Head of Partnerships
Acme Dataworks

Attachments: acme_security_responses.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Lena Park <lena.park@acmedata.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, integration@acmedata.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform integration: marketplace co-sell readiness for Acme Dataworks

Thanks both — looping in a couple of ops items from my side.

Connor: I'll take point on the SKU/pricing mapping. My immediate ask to Acme: can you confirm list price, committed discount tiers (if any), and whether you plan to offer trial entitlements? I want to align marketplace SKU dimensions (metering, entitlements) with Redwood SKU design so that the co-sell playbooks can reference a single canonical record.

Lena: on the data residency note, if you can point to the certificate/export for customer region ownership that will accelerate our internal compliance review. Also, if your KV cache change affects the cold-start pattern, we should capture expected token-latency deltas in the tech-eval spreadsheet — Priyom, can you add a short test plan?

Proposed deadlines:
- SKU/pricing confirmation from Acme: 2029-06-20
- Security evidence upload: 2029-06-19 (Lena/Priya)
- Redwood test plan and initial performance numbers: 2029-06-21 (Priyom)

I'll draft a simple Mutual Action Plan doc after we have those inputs and share for signoff.

Cheers,
Ben
Director, Alliances & GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_acme_mapp-v1.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acmedata.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform integration: marketplace co-sell readiness for Acme Dataworks

All —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary and owners (so nothing slips):

1) Security/evidence: Acme (Lena/Priya) — upload acme_security_responses.pdf to the Drive folder and confirm the data residency certificate by 2029-06-19 (complete).
2) SKU/pricing: Acme to send list price and entitlements by 2029-06-20 (Lena confirmed she'll share the SKU export). Ben to map to Redwood SKUs and return a consolidated sheet by 2029-06-20.
3) Performance tests: Priyom will draft the Redwood test plan and run latency/cold-start tests; deliverable: tech-eval-checklist.xlsx updated with numbers by 2029-06-21.
4) Next meeting: Wed 2029-06-19 10:00 PT — 30 minutes for evidence review and open blockers. I'll send the calendar invite now.

Ben — please draft the Mutual Action Plan (MAPP) after you reconcile the SKU fields; I'll circulate to legal/ops once we have those items.

Thanks — excited to get this listed and enable co-sell motion across AWS/Azure/GCP.

Connor
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmeShared — HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2029-ACME-47
